# MDL507 · `columns-count-mismatch`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

`columns_on_select` and `columns_on_insert` list different numbers of columns.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | tables |
| Default severity | warning |
| Fix | — |

## Why

mydumper selects the columns of `columns_on_select` and inserts them into those of `columns_on_insert`: with different counts, every INSERT of the dump fails at restore time.

## Example

❌ Before:

```ini
[`app`.`users`]
columns_on_select=id, concat(first, ',', last), email
columns_on_insert=id, full_name
```

```text
3:19-3:32 warning MDL507[columns-count-mismatch] columns_on_insert lists 2 columns, columns_on_select 3
  = Every INSERT of this table's dump fails at restore time.
  note 2:19-2:54: columns_on_select
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL507: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL507` on the line above it.
